# UK Accessories

> UK Accessories is an online mobile accessories and tech gadgets store serving customers in Pakistan. Slogan: "Upgrade Your Tech. Elevate Your Style." Prices are in PKR. Orders in Pakistan can be paid by Cash on Delivery, or by manual JazzCash/Easypaisa payment verified by the shop over WhatsApp. International delivery is not advertised as available yet.

## Key facts

- Website: https://uk-accessories.vercel.app/
- Brand: UK Accessories
- Market: Pakistan (primary); international customers are a secondary market, but international delivery is not advertised as available yet, until courier rates are confirmed.
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee)
- WhatsApp support: +92 3170851250 — default message: "Hello UK Accessories! I need assistance with your products and orders."
- Payment: Cash on Delivery in Pakistan; manual JazzCash/Easypaisa payment (share the transaction ID, the shop verifies it). No automatic payment integration is claimed, and no payment account numbers are published on this site.
- Prices shown are sample prices — confirm the price on WhatsApp before ordering if unsure.
- Product images are representative images, not exact photos of every model.
- No business email, social media links, opening hours, or customer reviews are published for UK Accessories, because none have been confirmed. No reviews have been invented.
- Physical shop context (separate from the online store): the owner's physical mobile shop is Umar Khayam Mobile Zone, KPK, Swabi, Shwa Adda, Abdus Sattar Plaza, Shop No. 16. UK Accessories is the online accessories store.

## Questions and answers

- What is UK Accessories? UK Accessories is an online mobile accessories and tech gadgets store serving customers in Pakistan.
- What products does UK Accessories sell? Wireless earbuds, headphones, fast chargers, charging cables, power banks, smartwatches, phone cases and screen protectors, priced in PKR.
- Do you offer Cash on Delivery? Yes, in Pakistan.
- Can I pay with JazzCash or Easypaisa? Yes, manually. Place the order, share your transaction ID, and the shop verifies it.
- Are prices final? No — current prices are sample prices. Confirm the price on WhatsApp before ordering if unsure.
- Do you deliver internationally? Not advertised as available yet, until courier rates are confirmed.
- How do I order on WhatsApp? Message +92 3170851250 with: "Hello UK Accessories! I need assistance with your products and orders."
- What is the shipping policy? Shipping is available in Pakistan. Demo shipping is Rs. 250, free over Rs. 5,000 (a demo rule, admin-configurable in the live store). Delivery estimates, zones and rates must be confirmed by the owner before they are promised.
- What if my item arrives damaged or incorrect? Contact UK Accessories on WhatsApp (+92 3170851250) with your order ID and photos. Manual-payment refunds are handled by the shop after verification.
